task.title: sharedServiceSelection LeaderOnly→All never recreates worker pods: InstanceSet in-place gate ignores component serviceName changes
task.body:
## Summary

Switching a leaderWorkerPattern role's `sharedServiceSelection` from `LeaderOnly` to `All` adds the worker **component's `serviceName`** in the RoleInstanceSet template — the pod template itself is byte-identical. Because nothing recreates the worker pod, it never gains the hostname/subdomain network identity that the `All` policy promises, and `sharedServiceSelection` round-trips silently wedge.

## Root cause chain

Verified from kind log artifacts of the failing e2e runs and reproduced in envtest:

1. hostname/subdomain are set **only at pod creation** (`setComponentPodIdentity`, `pkg/reconciler/roleinstance/core/instance_core.go:162`); there is no path that patches them onto a live pod.
2. The InstanceSet rollout's in-place gate — `canNotInPlaceUpdate` → `componentSizeChanges` (`pkg/inplace/instance/inplaceupdate/inplace_update_defaults.go:140`) — compares **only component sizes**, so a `serviceName`-only diff is judged in-place-able. The controller log shows that branch being taken (`Updating instance ... from=...-f96459f7 to=...-68b449cd84`, then `targets=[]`): the RoleInstance is patched in place, `deleteInstance` never runs, and the pods are never recreated.
3. The sibling RoleInstance/pod-level control already handles this correctly — `isComponentExtensionSpecChanged` (`pkg/reconciler/roleinstance/inplaceupdate/inplaceupdate.go:166`) compares the component `serviceName` and forces recreate. The InstanceSet-level gate is simply missing the equivalent check.

## Reproduction on main (`0821cb5b`)

An envtest case that creates a LeaderOnly LWP role, switches it to `All`, and asserts the worker **pod's** `subdomain` times out on upstream main: the RIS worker component `serviceName` is correctly added, but the pod is never recreated.

Note the existing `test/envtest/testcase/rbg/shared_service_selection_test.go` covers "All from creation" and "All→LeaderOnly" at the RIS level only — it asserts the component `serviceName`, which passes either way, so this gap is invisible to the current suite. Adding a pod-identity assertion for the LeaderOnly→All direction would pin it.

## E2E impact

`shared service selection should follow the policy round trip between LeaderOnly and All` fails deterministically on PR #487's head (4/4 runs across both e2e jobs), while passing on upstream main and on #487's earlier (2026-09-28) head — main's e2e appears to be one timing/state shift away from the same failure. The exact trigger that makes it fire on one head and not another was not pinned down (leading suspects: suite-state pollution from #487's new orphan-adoption e2e spec, or a timing shift around instance availability).

## Suggested fix

Extend `canNotInPlaceUpdate` to compare component `serviceName` (mirroring `isComponentExtensionSpecChanged`), so a serviceName change falls back to delete-and-recreate and the worker pod comes back with its network identity.

Related: #487 (its e2e CI is currently blocked by this).
